periods.summary: Sirius is introduced as Stella's intensely doting father and Vermillion's king. He previously demanded that Ikki visit Vermillion after Seven Stars, but secretly prepared a national interception plan: citizens, the army, bounties, royal guards, and Dandalion are all used to keep Ikki from the castle. His scheme collapses when Ikki reaches the castle and Lunaeyes broadcasts the truth. After Stella breaks down in anger and grief, Sirius is cornered by his family and agrees that if Ikki brings victory in the upcoming war against Quedolan, he will consider accepting the marriage.

key_events.summary: His covert plan turns Ikki's arrival into a nationwide test.
Is forced to accept the war-victory condition for Ikki and Stella's engagement.

periods.summary: Sirius tries to recover paternal dignity by challenging Ikki to simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon, losing every time while learning how formidable and sincere Ikki is. When Stella reports that Or-Gaule is controlling Quedland's people, Sirius rejects the coldly rational option of hiding the truth and ordering lethal defense. He tells General Signa that Quedland's army has no true hostile will, commands the army not to kill or die, and declares that Vermillion will save Quedland because thirty years of shared trust cannot be discarded. He also accepts Ikki's role as a Vermillion representative if Ikki can lead the country to victory. During the palace attack, Sirius resists Ein's pollen paralysis with Blazing Great Axe but is quickly disabled by Thorn Whip.

key_events.summary: Challenges Ikki in multiple trials and loses while revealing his jealous fatherly affection.
Orders the army to save Quedland's controlled soldiers rather than kill them.
Fights Ein after she poisons the palace but is crippled by her thorn attack.

periods.summary: Sirius's decision to fight Quedland with nonlethal riot gear expresses his loyalty to Quedland but gives Lunaeyes grounds to criticize him for risking Vermillion lives. After Caldia he rushes to confirm his daughters' safety and reveals an unexpected helper protected the palace. He wants to take the fifth representative slot as king and knight, but Nene bluntly rejects him as a liability in a Desperado-class melee. While Stella goes to Edelberg, he worries and asks Nene if she should have stopped her. On the eve of war he tries to help citizens prepare the national funeral vigil by supplying palace alcohol, only to be scolded by Lunaeyes.

key_events.summary: Arrives after Caldia and debates Lunaeyes's negotiation and his earlier orders.
Attempts to volunteer but is rejected by Nene.

periods.summary: During Vermillion's state funeral, Sirius explains to Ikki that Vermillion funerals are loud because the living must laugh so the dead will not regret leaving loved ones in sorrow. He then confronts Ikki over the report that Ikki stopped Edelweiss from saving Stella during her near-death awakening. Although furious as a father, Sirius tests Ikki's reasoning. Ikki says he loves Stella and therefore could not obstruct her chosen identity as the Crimson Princess; Sirius cannot accept this as a father but confirms that the earlier promise still stands: Ikki must prove himself with his sword if he wants Stella. Later, Lunaeyes privately announces that she will renounce succession to stay beside John. Sirius recognizes that John is the true personal reason and, despite the political cost and his own loneliness, tells Lunaeyes to go do what only she can do. Watching the war afterward, he complains about losing a daughter but has already chosen her happiness over keeping her in Vermillion.

key_events.summary: Explains funeral customs and challenges Ikki about Stella's near-death trial.
Flashback reveals Sirius permitted Lunaeyes to renounce succession and rescue John.
